The funding round was led by Contrarian Ventures, with participation from Axeleo Capital and Curiosity.

products.name: Indurex SafeGuard AI
products.description: AI原生平台，摄取分布式控制系统、安全仪表系统、历史数据库、报警管理系统和IT安全工具的数据，利用AI代理发现异常和工程偏差，将网络安全告警与物理过程关联，提供统一视图和推荐行动。
products.target_customers: 石油和天然气、能源、公用事业、制造业和数据中心等关键基础设施运营商
features: 统一工程、安全与网络安全数据
AI代理标记异常和工程偏差
关联网络安全告警与物理过程
自动化合规报告（IEC 62443、IEC 61511/61508、NIS2、NIST CSF、NERC CIP）

evidence_refs.quote: Its offering is called Indurex SafeGuard AI, a platform that ingests data from distributed control systems, safety instrumented systems, historians, alarm management systems, and IT security tools. It then uses AI agents to surface anomalies and engineering deviations, giving operators a unified view that links cybersecurity alerts directly to the physical process behind them, something conventional OT security systems have failed to address.

comparisons.name: Dragos
comparisons.scenario: 工业控制系统网络安全监控与威胁检测
comparisons.funding_summary: Accenture于2026年6月同意以32.5亿美元估值收购多数股权
comparisons.core_difference: Indurex聚焦工程数据与物理过程关联，而非仅网络监控；Dragos为传统OT安全平台，被大型买家整合。

evidence_refs.quote: Accenture agreed in June 2026 to take a majority stake in Dragos at a $3.25 billion valuation.

comparisons.name: Armis
comparisons.scenario: 工业与物联网资产可见性与安全
comparisons.funding_summary: ServiceNow于2025年12月同意以约77.5亿美元收购
comparisons.core_difference: Indurex强调工程配置与安全功能层，Armis侧重网络连接资产可见性。

evidence_refs.quote: ServiceNow agreed in December 2025 to buy Armis for about $7.75 billion.

comparisons.name: Nozomi Networks
comparisons.scenario: 工业网络威胁检测与可见性
comparisons.core_difference: Indurex关注工程数据与安全功能偏差，Nozomi侧重网络层监控。

evidence_refs.quote: Mitsubishi Electric’s acquisition of Nozomi Networks has followed the same pattern.

comparisons.name: Claroty
comparisons.funding_summary: 2026年1月完成1.5亿美元F轮融资，由Golub Growth领投
comparisons.core_difference: Indurex以工程智能层为核心，Claroty为传统OT安全平台并持续独立融资。

evidence_refs.quote: Claroty took a different route and raised $150 million in a Series F in January 2026, led by Golub Growth, with up to $50 million more committed by existing investors.

comparisons.name: Exein
comparisons.product: 机器人、无人机和车辆安全
comparisons.target_customer: 机器人、无人机和车辆制造商
comparisons.funding_summary: 2025年12月融资1亿欧元，2026年9月以17亿美元估值融资2.7亿美元，由Headline领投
comparisons.core_difference: Indurex面向工业CPS的工程与安全数据层，Exein面向机器人、无人机和车辆等物理AI设备安全。

evidence_refs.quote: Rome-based Exein, which TFN covered when it raised €100 million in December 2025, then secured $270 million at a $1.7 billion valuation in a round led by Headline, announced on September 15. Exein is aiming at a different target: security for robots, drones and vehicles.
Indurex, an Amsterdam-based startup building an AI-native platform for Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) security, has raised €7 million in funding, less than nine months after coming out of stealth.
Indurex has already secured four industrial plants, received a letter of intent from a major OEM, and been recognised by Gartner as a Cool Vendor.

quotes.speaker: Rokas Peciulaitis
quotes.quote: Electrification is putting more critical infrastructure online, and attacks on it are rising, with the damage felt in the physical world: cold homes, dark hospitals, water that stops flowing. Detection alone is no longer enough. Operators need to understand what an alert means for the physical process behind it. Having built and sold a company in this space, Jalal knows what operators across oil and gas, power and manufacturing need, which makes Indurex one of very few companies that understands both the network packet and the physical process

quotes.speaker: Jalal Bouhdada
quotes.quote: Cyber defences in these critical sectors have focused solely on the network. We focus on the core industrial data itself: the engineering, process and safety signals that determine whether a plant is operating within safe limits. Cybersecurity and operational excellence have too often been managed as separate disciplines — Engineering Intelligence is the missing layer, and this funding allows us to bring that capability to more operators across critical infrastructure

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是Indurex能否证明物理风险首先出现在工厂工程数据中，并将该能力转化为运营商合同。当前已验证信号包括：完成€7M融资、获得Gartner Cool Vendor认可、已签约四个工业厂区及收到一家主要OEM的意向书。但来源未披露客户名称、合同金额、收入或估值，且公司未披露总融资额和轮次类型，因此商业化验证仍处于早期阶段。
validated_signals: 完成€7M融资，由Contrarian Ventures领投，Axeleo Capital和Curiosity参投
收到一家主要OEM的意向书
risks: 来源未披露具体客户名称和合同金额，商业化收入尚未验证
公司未披露总融资额、估值和轮次类型，资本结构不透明
OT安全领域竞争激烈，大型厂商正通过并购整合，Indurex需证明差异化价值
SANS调查等第三方行业数据仅作需求背景，不构成公司实绩
